node.title: Consumer-scoped Conjecture F: prize flat sections have poly unpaid points
node.statement: For every actual LIST/MCA flat emitted by f_prize_consumer_flat_scope, the D_j-points are, up to n^{B_F} exceptions, assigned to a tangent/shared-divisor owner or a proper quotient/dihedral pullback owner. This is the consumer theorem required by the prize DAG; the unqualified statement for every abstract linear flat is not claimed.
node.attack_surface: prove coordinate planes first (= prob:perfiber, minimal instance), then kernel planes; the crux is classifying exceptional planes (ES-type)
node.falsifier: a toy-scale plane family (n = 16..32, enumerable) with super-poly D_j points, no deep shared divisor, no pullback symmetry
node.notes: The gcd and scale reductions are proved. FALSE-GREEN REPAIR 2026-08-07: the primitive input is conditional on the explicit prize-consumer scope, absolute-exponent packing, and higher-weight Face-4 payment leaves. This node states only the consumer theorem needed by the prize DAG.
